prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film: real people with real skin, pores and stubble, in real places. The photograph is breaking up into the coarse printing dots of a 1920s newspaper: at the edges of the frame the scene is nothing but huge cyan, magenta, yellow and black dots, shrinking towards the centre, where it becomes a fully realistic photograph. A tall skinny man in a bowler hat with a heavy gold mayoral chain round his neck, a long narrow face, hollow cheeks and a pencil-thin grey moustache grins into a big chrome radio microphone, reading from a script, a lit red lamp on the wall behind him. Camera low across the desk, the microphone large in the foreground. Light: a warm desk lamp under his face; the studio behind in deep shadow. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
